newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on CBOT soy gains but off highs.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on CBOT soy gains but off highs.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up on higher CBOT soycomplex values, traders said.

"The November was reacting to the U.S. markets. We had hedges into the close, commercial buying by Richardson Greenshields and some profit taking," a trader said. Commission houses liquidated longs, LFG bought November, hedges selling pressured futures, traders said. Sep-Nov spread at $5.20. Volume was 2,955 lots, or 59,100 tonnes, with 295 hedges.
September canola rose $2 to $426.50, November rose $2 to $431.70. November flax fell $1 to $362. Volume was 110 lots.
UGG bought five October peas unchanged at US$204, traders said.
October feed wheat lost $2.80 to $200.20 and December lost $1.20 to $187 on StatsCan's report, light hedges with some commercial support. Volume was 425 lots. Oats did not trade.
November western barley slipped $0.60 to $155 on hedge selling, February fell $0.50 to $160.80 on StatsCan's report.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
